title: Privileges & anti-defection: more rules, cases, recent disputes

boxes.title: More provisions
items: Aim: curb defections =="induced by the lure of office"== + horse-trading
91st (2003): disqualified defector barred as Minister / remunerative political post till re-elected: ==**Arts 75(1B), 164(1B), 361B**==
Covers **Legislative Council** members too; works on the **"legislature party"**
Independent becoming **independent minister** without party membership also caught
Giving up membership: e.g. **publicly campaigning** for opposition, no resignation letter
Para 4 has **two tests**: original party merges **and** two-thirds agree; neither mergers nor stayers disqualified

boxes.title: Cases: added detail
head: Case
Point
rows: Privilege decisions reviewable only for ==gross illegality / unconstitutionality==
Constitution Bench; no breach of free speech or basic structure; review grounds: **mala fides, perversity**, natural justice, constitutional mandate
Shiv Sena case; two-thirds of legislators cannot create a =="deemed merger"==
Disqualification of **17** rebel MLAs upheld; Speaker cannot bar contesting till end of term

items.what: SC time-bound direction to **Telangana Speaker**; **7** petitions rejected Dec 2025
Final ==**3 weeks**== for last **2 of 10 BRS MLAs** (to Congress); **contempt** warning
AAP RS "merger" with BJP incl. **Raghav Chadha**
**AIADMK** Palaniswami camp cites Subhash Desai for whip
TMC MPs tell Speaker **Om Birla** of merger with **Nationalist Citizens Party of India** (⚠ other source: National People's Congress of India)
Justices **P.S. Narasimha & Alok Aradhe**: plea on deemed merger; shortcomings =="matters for Parliament"==

boxes.title: Reform & debate extras
items: **Kunal Kamra** summoned by Maharashtra Council's Privileges Committee
1984: **NTR** restored after a month; June 2019 merger accepted by **RS Chairman**
**Election Commission**: President/Governor to decide on EC's ==binding advice==
Law Commission: limit whips to votes threatening the government
Jul 2026: **fixed constitutional timelines** for Speakers proposed
Critics: muzzles dissent, law left =="impotent"==; courts shaped it more than Parliament since **2003**
